rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2AA label and gives a plausible blastocyst description, but it infers features not clearly verifiable from a single image (minimal fragmentation, symmetry, possible collapse artifact) and slightly blurs grade 2/full blastocyst terminology.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, smoking, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat formulaic probability adjustments and assumptions such as trilaminar endometrium and single usable blastocyst.

Mostly aligned on SET, smoking cessation, and age-related counseling, but includes less guideline-based suggestions such as routine assisted hatching consideration, ERA after a single failure implication, thrombophilia/immune testing, and DHEA/antioxidants without strong universal support.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including counseling and possible workup, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care.
